description: This file defines the ContentTypesSitemapSourceDriver class, a display driver for managing sitemap content types in OrchardCore, including display, editing, and updating sitemap source configurations.

classes.name: ContentTypesSitemapSourceDriver
classes.description: A display driver class for handling sitemap source content types, including display, editing, and updating logic.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Handles the display logic for the sitemap source, rendering summary and thumbnail views.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Prepares the editing view model with content type definitions and current sitemap source settings.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes the submitted form data to update the sitemap source configuration.
